sum: Performance Shipping Inc. provides shipping transportation services through its tanker vessels worldwide. As of December 31, 2025, it operated through a fleet of nine Aframax tanker vessels and two Suezmax tanker vessels with a combined carrying capacity of 1,287,118 DWT. The company was incorporated in 2010 and is based in Athens, Greece.
ceo: Mr. Andreas Nikolaos Michalopoulos (MD, CEO, Secretary & Director)
